assessments.name: Supervisor evaluation of student contribution after Thesis/Capstone A
assessments.description:
This component relates to the main supervisor's assessment of the student's:
(i) Project management skill and organisation
(ii) Communication and reliability
(ii) Personal application to the project work
(iv) Creativity
(v) Perseverance
assessments.type: Peer or expert observation or supervision

assessments.name: Seminar Presentation Q&A Component
assessments.description: Live Q&A following the Seminar Presentation
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement
